greeting: Quick! I have deliveries! What do you need sent?
Messenger Gale! Fastest balloon in Tide!
No time to chat! Unless you have a message!
Back again? Something to send? URGENTLY?
Welcome to Postal Platform! We go UP to get AROUND!
New face! Need message delivery? I'm your aeronaut!
The wind waits for no one! And neither do I!
Speed is my specialty! Well, speed AND altitude!
dialog.delivery_offer: Letters! Packages! Small livestock! If it fits in the basket, I'll deliver it!
dialog.speed_guarantee: Same-day delivery to any coastal zone! Next-day to inland! Weather permitting!
dialog.route_stories: Once delivered a letter to a moving ship! Target practice! Hit the deck on my third pass!
dialog.competition: Seagulls are my rivals. Faster than them going up. They win going down. Unfair advantage.
rumor: Carried a love letter from Tide to Frost once. Romance across zones! Heartwarming!
Aetherreach gets ALL the priority mail. VIP treatment. Hmph.
Dustbelt's so dry, balloons get static shocks. Dangerous!
Mire's fog makes landing impossible. I drop packages from above.
dialog.balloon_maintenance: Balloon needs constant patching. Seagulls. Wind. Jealous pigeons. It's a war up there!
farewell: Send a letter! I'll deliver it! PROMISE!
Up, up, and away! Real work to do!
Catch me if you can! ...In the sky! Good luck!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning route! Catching the east wind!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening return! Last drops of the day!
dialog.time_night: Night flying? Too dangerous. Grounded until dawn.

party_reactions.kade: Fastest mail service I've ever seen.
party_reactions.twist: You go FAST?! Can I RIDE?!
party_reactions.korr: Reliable communication binds the zones together.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever carry magical correspondence? Enchanted letters?
party_reactions.suresh: Haste makes waste. But sometimes, speed saves.
party_reactions.sova: Good way to scout. From the basket. Smart.
party_reactions.grit: Couriers won battles. Information moves armies.
party_reactions.senna: Fast escape route. If you have a balloon.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First class? Express? What's your speed need?
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular customer! I'll prioritize your mail!
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Your letters always get VIP treatment!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Free deliveries! Forever! You've earned it!
